title: Juicy Nostalgic Earthy Tofu Stir-fry
description: A Mediterranean-inspired keto-friendly dish featuring marinated tofu with earthy flavors for a nostalgic and juicy culinary experience.
instructions: Preheat your broiler to high heat.
Marinate the tofu in a mixture of olive oil and herbs (like thyme or oregano) for at least an hour. Rinse and pat dry before use.
In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil over medium-high heat. Add minced garlic and onions, cooking until softened about 3-4 minutes.
Add bell peppers and marinated tofu to the skillet, stirring gently to combine ingredients. Cook for another 5-7 minutes or until tofu is golden brown on all sides.
Drizzle remaining olive oil over the tofu mixture and sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste. Stir-fry for an additional minute to enhance flavors.
Serve hot as a lunch dish.
